description: Source code implementing a POSIX-compatible file descriptor table for Zephyr OS, including functions for managing file descriptors, their associated objects, and standard I/O operations.

classes.name: fd_entry
classes.description: Structure representing a file descriptor entry, including object pointer, vtable, reference count, lock, and condition variable.

methods.name: z_fd_ref
methods.description: Increment reference count for a file descriptor.

methods.name: z_fd_unref
methods.description: Decrement reference count for a file descriptor and clean up if count reaches zero.

methods.name: _find_fd_entry
methods.description: Find an available file descriptor index.

methods.name: z_get_fd_obj
methods.description: Retrieve the object associated with a file descriptor, with optional vtable check.

methods.name: z_get_fd_by_obj_and_vtable
methods.description: Find a file descriptor by object and vtable.

methods.name: z_get_obj_lock_and_cond
methods.description: Get lock and condition variable for a given object and vtable.

methods.name: z_get_fd_obj_and_vtable
methods.description: Retrieve object and vtable for a given file descriptor.

methods.name: z_reserve_fd
methods.description: Reserve a new file descriptor index.

methods.name: z_finalize_fd
methods.description: Finalize and initialize a file descriptor with object and vtable.

methods.name: z_alloc_fd
methods.description: Allocate and initialize a new file descriptor with object and vtable.
